purpose: Fixed-camera 2.5D visual layer for the FondaVS projector stage. It adds depth, parallax and grounded shadows while the existing 2D game rules remain authoritative.
runtimeSurface: Next.js host route with a 960x540 Canvas 2D stage, scaled responsively for the projector viewport.

hero.role: shared game board and team presentation plane

exceptions: game-specific playfields and score labels are intentionally asymmetric when the rules require it.

circulation.description: There is no walkable 3D avatar space. The player envelope is screen-space only: the host board remains fully visible and controls stay on mobile routes.
